culprit_citations.quoted_text: 190 Octane Financing, LLC - Term Loan (12) | SOFR + 5.50% (1.00% floor) + 2.25% PIK | 11.52% | fair value 7,375

findings.detail: E07's source population pooled the separate comparative investment schedule with the March 31, 2026 schedule, inflating source rows relative to current-period output.

rationale: Raw source shows two distinct full investment schedules. The March 31, 2026 schedule ends at table 18 row 7 with fair value 624,289 thousand, exactly matching the output quarter anchor of 624.289 million. A separate comparative schedule ends at table 28 row 5 with fair value 648,055 thousand; table 21 also repeats the same 190 Octane instrument with a different 11.52% rate and 7,375 fair value versus 11.47% and 7,275 in the current schedule. Therefore the 321-versus-123 E07 count mismatch is caused by comparative-period rows entering the source-side count, while the output is correctly scoped to the current schedule.
